paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Critic model choices. Both follow the SIM-RAG setting with GPT-4 as the Reasoner, but the blue bar uses learned Flan-T5-783M as a Critic, while the red bar uses GPT-4 as the Critic (a.k.a., self-critique).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of the performance of two different Critic models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across various question-answering datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists six categories: TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1), where EM and F1 refer to different evaluation metrics. The vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from 25 to 85, with a linear scale and labeled tick marks. The chart features two sets of bars, one for Flan-T5-783M (blue) and one for GPT-4 (red), with approximate values as follows: TriviaQA (EM) - 77.3 (blue), 77.1 (red); HotPotQA (EM) - 37.0 (blue), 31.9 (red); 2Wiki (EM) - 44.5 (blue), 32.5 (red); TriviaQA (F1) - 82.8 (blue), 83.8 (red); HotPotQA (F1) - 49.7 (blue), 43.3 (red); 2Wiki (F1) - 53.3 (blue), 38.1 (red). The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding, which differentiates between the two Critic models being compared.
